cinematic-bars.config.title: Cinematic Bars Settings
cinematic-bars.option.bar_height.desc:
Height of each bar as a percentage of the screen height.
The reference recording used about 8%.
cinematic-bars.option.edge_feather.desc:
How soft the inner edge of each bar is, as a percentage of the bar height.
0% gives a hard, aliased edge.
cinematic-bars.option.duration.desc:
Time for a full open or close transition, in milliseconds.
Defaults to 450ms.
cinematic-bars.option.curve.desc:
How the bars accelerate while sliding.
Defaults to ease out quad: quick to start, gentle to settle.
cinematic-bars.option.pinned.desc:
Keep the bars on screen permanently, without a key.
This disables the activation mode.
cinematic-bars.option.activation_mode.de:
Hold keeps the bars up while the key is held;
toggle flips them on each press.
cinematic-bars.option.activation_key.des:
Click, then press the key or mouse button you want to use.
Backspace clears the binding; the default is left Shift.
cinematic-bars.option.show_when_hud_hidd:
Keep drawing the bars while the HUD is hidden with F1.
Useful for clean recordings.
